records.text: Gilbert Trejo said his father Danny was booked on a film represented as not pro-ICE or overtly pro-anything, accepted a good-guy shop-owner role, and learned about Ben Shapiro's involvement about two weeks into shooting; he said his father had never heard of Shapiro.
records.speaker: Gilbert Trejo

appearances.snippet: The statement from Danny Trejo's son reads, for anyone seeing this. ... "Ish with my dad, he was booked on a film. It's not pro-ICE. It's not overtly pro-anything. His agent described it as, quote, a complicated story about a complicated time where everyone looks bad except you, the hardworking Mexican shop owner who just wants peace. He jumped at the idea of playing a good guy. About two weeks into shooting, everyone, including us, found out Ben Shapiro was involved." That's, that is so exactly what I think happened, by the way. "My 82-year-old dad said he had never heard of Ben Shapiro. I had to explain"
